name: Card pipeline (steps after the business gate not yet tested)

nodes.title: Business gate (biz-gate)
nodes.instructions: Run the biz-gate agent on the ClickUp card named in the request, following the card-refine skill steps 1-5 (evidence first, one folder per card, production check for bugs). Do not post anything to ClickUp. Return the biz-gate output in full. End with pass only when VERDICT is PASS and CONFIDENCE is HIGH; otherwise blocked, with the draft and checks as evidence so a person can decide.

nodes.title: Tech design review
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Review how to build the card that passed the business gate (its output is upstream). Read the code read-only. Cover: what existing code to reuse, data and migration changes, whether existing callers and data keep working, performance. Name files and lines. If the business information is not enough to decide, end blocked with each missing point as evidence.

nodes.title: Architecture review
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Review where the change belongs: which repo and engine own it, whether it stays inside one project, the order of changes across repos, and whether it follows the engine layout and dependency rules the team documents. Read the code read-only. Name files and lines. If the business information is not enough to decide, end blocked with each missing point as evidence.

nodes.title: UI and testing review
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Review the screens and the test plan: which existing sibling screen to copy (layout, fields, journey), what to test (specs, system specs), and what test data or account is needed. Read the code read-only. Name files and lines. If the business information is not enough to decide, end blocked with each missing point as evidence.

nodes.title: Plan
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Merge the three reviews into a design brief (decisions, open questions, risks, steps that need a person's OK), then write the implementation plan: tasks with the files each owns, dependencies and acceptance criteria. Group independent tasks into 2-4 parallel paths that never share a file when that helps. Steps that cannot be undone (production data, money, messages to customers, push, land) are marked as waiting for a person. Do not modify code. If an upstream check failed, fix every finding it lists.

nodes.title: Verify plan
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Verify the plan against the card, the design brief and the actual code: every task is testable, no two paths touch the same file, irreversible steps wait for a person. Pass only if the plan is complete and executable; otherwise fail with each gap.

nodes.title: Implement
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Implement the verified plan in this workspace, test first. Follow the repository's conventions. Run the specs for the files you touched. Do not commit, push or touch production. If an upstream review failed, fix every finding it lists. Done means the acceptance concerns hold for the repo's project (specs pass and run clean, nothing lost on the remote, the engine boots on its own where it is an engine, migrations only change schema, no needless recurring jobs, names say what they are); report each as PASS / FAIL / N/A with the evidence command.

nodes.title: Review (cross-family)
nodes.instructions: NOT YET TESTED on real cards (card-pipeline 0.1.0): follow these instructions, but report anything that does not fit what you find. Independently review the implementation against the verified plan and the acceptance concerns. Inspect the actual diff and relevant files, run the relevant specs. Pass only when no blocking finding remains and every concern is PASS or N/A with evidence; otherwise fail with specific findings. Done means the acceptance concerns hold for the repo's project (specs pass and run clean, nothing lost on the remote, the engine boots on its own where it is an engine, migrations only change schema, no needless recurring jobs, names say what they are); report each as PASS / FAIL / N/A with the evidence command.

nodes.title: Report
nodes.instructions: Write the run report for the session: the card (linked by name) and its business-gate verdict, the design brief in short, what was built (files, rounds), a table with one row per acceptance concern (PASS / FAIL / N/A and the evidence command), and anything waiting on a person. Nothing is pushed or landed. End pass.
